hypothesis: At a blocked forced prefix, committing a short-path future launch slot can reduce repeated source denial and later EBS/FIFO backlog while preserving continuous motion. Future booking can also delay others; system gains are not guaranteed.

future_policy.trigger: current immediate DFS failed with a calendar conflict before the first static optional branch; not a budget-only or bound-only failure
future_policy.certificate: intersection of all device occupancy and directed-edge entrance windows on the complete chain; earliest legal integer launch on that chain, not globally earliest
future_policy.cap: freeze cap at actual attempt; future elapsed travel measured from proposed launch
future_policy.admission: reserve now, keep source FIFO head until actual launch; no internal waits; first clock unchanged
future_policy.horizon_independence: do not truncate future reservation search or reject planned launch merely because observation ends earlier

input_population: unaltered canonical 1x/2x tasks, no faults or empty trays, 2m/s, originally positive nodes 2s, original zero nodes remain zero
prerequisites: default-off deterministic parity against 006 on meaningful microcases
future reserve/launch physical and timing microcases, including observed-horizon crossing and exact 2s equality
independent rolling, headway, source-policy, THT and business audit gates
execution_order: nanning_1x_original_window if the implementation remains physically valid
map2_1x_original_window if the implementation remains physically valid
primary: full-population business mean THT, sum of finish minus immutable first actual planning attempt over transport legs, excluding EBS storage
mandatory: fixed original window completed businesses at 98259
preplanning hold and nominal summed leg elapsed
event-engine CPU/wall and source decision tail latency
future-search work, precommit/launch/pending counts and in-route work
comparison: same repaired HCA input/physics/source-policy baseline; no comparison of G31 event CPU to whole Java runtime
decision: Do not promote from a single-bag benefit or lower completed-subset THT. Preserve every failed experiment and quantify tradeoffs versus 006 and HCA. Full short-versus-drain prefix parity required before any final promotion.
claim_boundary: Development experiment chosen after observing 006 failures, not an untouched held-out validation. Serial simulation safety negotiation, not deployed distributed mutual exclusion.
